description: This file defines a class 'LeaveProfileNode' that extends the Node class within the Twig Profiler package, representing a node used during profiling that indicates leaving a profile scope.

classes.name: LeaveProfileNode
classes.description: Represents a profile leave node in the Twig profiler, used to mark the end of a profiling scope.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of LeaveProfileNode with the specified variable name.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to indicate the profiler is leaving the profile scope.
